---
title: "SeekDeep"
subtitle: "Single-base resolution haplotype calling for targeted amplicon sequencing"
toc: false
---

SeekDeep takes targeted amplicon sequencing data from many samples and works out which haplotypes
each sample carries, and at what frequency, down to single-base differences. It handles Illumina
paired-end, Illumina single-end and nanopore reads, panels from a handful of targets to several
hundred, and samples with or without PCR replicates and in-line barcodes (MIDs). It grew out of
*Plasmodium* work, where infections are often polyclonal, but nothing in it is specific to
*Plasmodium*.

## How it works

The analysis has three stages, each a SeekDeep command:

1. **Extraction**: reads are sorted into targets by their primers (and into samples by MIDs, if
   there are any) and filtered on length and quality. Illumina mates are stitched together where
   the target is short enough to overlap.
   `extractorPairedEnd`, `extractor` (single-end) and `extractorByKmerMatching` (nanopore).
2. **Per-sample clustering**: each target in each sample is clustered into haplotypes, separating
   real differences from sequencing and PCR errors.
   `qluster` for Illumina, which uses the read quality scores, and `kluster` for nanopore, which uses k-mer similarity.
3. **Population clustering**: haplotypes are compared across samples, replicates are combined so
   that only haplotypes found in every replicate are kept, and the same haplotype is given the same
   name in every sample.
   `processClusters`.

The results come out as tables and as a [Portable Microhaplotype Object
(PMO)](https://plasmogenepi.github.io/PMO_Docs/). They can optionally include variant calls and
amino acid changes against a reference genome (`variantCallOnSeqAndProtein`), and can be browsed in
a [local viewer](running/viewers.qmd).

## How to run it

The recommended way to run SeekDeep is with the
[elucidatornf](https://github.com/nickjhathaway/elucidatornf) Nextflow workflows. They chain these
steps together, work out most extraction settings from your primers and reference genomes, run in
Docker or Apptainer, and produce reports. See
[Running with elucidatornf](running/elucidatornf.qmd).

Every step can also be run directly as a SeekDeep command. The [command reference](reference/index.qmd)
lists every command and flag.
